encoding: JPEG, row 0 = north — same orientation as the heightmap
resolutionNote: The source is 20 cm. This drape is resampled by the WMS to about 1.0 m per pixel, because the terrain mesh beneath it is at 16 m posting and a 2-gigapixel texture is neither loadable nor useful. It is a photograph of the ground, not a measurement, and nothing is derived from it.
acquisition: LDBV Bayernbefliegung; the flight date varies by tile and is not per-pixel

tiles.note: Row 0 is north, column 0 is west. The full mosaic stays in drape.jpg for reference and is NOT loaded by the app when this block is present.
